mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_vacation_request (employee_id, start_date, end_date, days, reason, status, approval_document_id) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{days}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{approvalDocumentId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, start_date, end_date, days, reason, status, approval_document_id, created_at FROM attendance_vacation_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
